name: async-button
title: Async button
description: A button for an action that takes a moment: it locks while pending, shows success or failure in place without changing width, and returns to rest by itself.
docs: Return a promise from onClick, or drive the button from your own state with status={mutation.status}. It uses aria-disabled while pending so focus stays on the button, and it is as wide as its longest label so nothing jumps.
